items.title: Aeroflex hits record high of Rs 599.7 intraday; no catalyst disclosed
items.text: Aeroflex Industries rose as much as 15.23% intraday on 12 October 2026 to an all-time high of Rs 599.7, after two straight days of decline. MarketsMOJO's report names no company announcement behind the move and says it may be stock-specific or technical. The stock is a liquid-cooling skid and hose proxy, so the rally raises valuation risk if skid orders and the capacity ramp do not follow.

sources.title: Aeroflex Industries Ltd Surges 10.94% to Day's High of Rs 599.7

items.title: Savita Oil hits record high of Rs 862.80, up 200% year to date
items.text: Whalesbook reports Savita Oil Technologies touched a record Rs 862.80 on the BSE, up 200% year to date and 25% in September while the Sensex fell 5.6%. It cites Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 1,513 crore and PBT of Rs 387 crore. The article attributes growth to demand for transformer oils used in power grids and data centres, not to liquid-cooling fluids. Savita has not disclosed data-centre coolant revenue, so the re-rating is not yet evidence of fluids traction.

sources.title: Savita Oil Technologies Hits Record High After 200% Rally
